description: Need an excuse? Pick work, school, or social — then mild, bold, or outrageous — for a ready-made alibi in one click.

faqs.a: Work, school, and social — each with mild (believable), bold (suspicious), and outrageous (hilarious) excuse banks.
faqs.q: What categories and severities are there?

faqs.a: These are for fun and fiction. Mild ones are plausible; outrageous ones are deliberately absurd.
faqs.q: Are these excuses meant to be used for real?

faqs.a: Click any excuse or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy an excuse?

howto: Pick a category and a severity level.
Click any excuse to copy it.
title: Excuse Generator
